subject.title: Improve context overflow error message with specifics

question: Which privacy-safe session label and token-measurement semantics should the shared user-visible overflow diagnostic use?
rationale: Current code has several measurement sources with different accuracy, and raw session identifiers may reveal transport-specific IDs; repository inspection cannot determine the intended public disclosure contract.

options.title: Redacted label plus typed measurements
options.body: Show a human-friendly redacted session/channel label, provider/model, effective budget, and explicitly marked estimated or provider-reported usage and overage.

options.title: Model and budget only
options.body: Show provider/model and budget/overage diagnostics but omit all session identity from user-visible errors.

options.title: Full session identity
options.body: Show the canonical session key and all available measurements, accepting transport-identifier disclosure and channel-specific privacy risk.

recommendation.title: Redacted label plus typed measurements
recommendation.body: Show a human-friendly redacted session/channel label, provider/model, effective budget, and explicitly marked estimated or provider-reported usage and overage.

likelyOwner.reason: The prior review and recent compaction/recovery work span the runner and reply boundaries where the product disclosure contract must be coordinated.
